instructions: Create a separate folding-cap accessory with a clear attachment origin.
Use original procedural geometry only; no downloaded meshes, textures or celebrity likeness.
Produce static review-stage models, not automatically accepted production assets.
assumptions: The generator uses fixed estimated adult proportions or accessory dimensions; no clothing fit or surveyed measurement is claimed.
Reference sources inform geometry; their images have not been imported.
Cultural and architectural fidelity requires human review.
review_checks: Review folding silhouette rather than calling an arbitrary hat a Gandhi cap.
Check fit against the adult base before acceptance.
construction_notes: Use a low elongated folding-cap outline and a visible central fold.
Keep the accessory origin on the centre axis; attachment height/fit is a later rig integration task.
